harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance on node1 to run daily at 02:15 via root's crontab, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. The pre-existing script file was corrupted (leftover heredoc/install artifacts instead of valid shell), so it was rewritten to a clean, executable (0755 root:root) script before wiring up cron. Completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured a healthy baseline, issued a self-acknowledging reboot, polled through the outage, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified crond active/enabled, cron entry intact, script intact, and log file retaining both pre- and post-reboot entries.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance and found it non-executable (644) with corrupted heredoc/install remnants left in the file body
Rewrote the script to a clean POSIX sh script and installed it at 0755 root:root via sudo -n install
Created/verified /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log ownership (root:root) and permissions (0644)
Installed a root crontab entry: 15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1, replacing any prior inventory-maintenance line
Verified crond service active and crontab entry present
Manually ran the script to confirm it executes and appends correctly to the log
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, crond status, crontab contents, log contents
Issued a self-acknowledging systemctl reboot on node1 (backgrounded so the exec call returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 through connection timeouts/reset until it came back online
Confirmed boot_id changed (7223d5b7-fa56-4ff3-acee-959a5cf5f146 -> 4ba52a94-c37e-469e-bebf-e7d2eb7e8517), proving an actual restart
Post-restart verified crond active/enabled, cron entry persisted, script permissions/content intact, and re-ran the script to confirm the log retained the prior entry plus a new post-reboot entry

evidence.requirement: inventory-maintenance script exists, is valid and executable
evidence.summary: Found script corrupted/non-executable, then rewrote and verified 0755 root:root with correct content

evidence.requirement: cron job scheduled daily at 02:15 running the script
evidence.summary: Installed and verified root crontab line '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'
Simulated the exact cron command; log file received the appended completion line
Captured boot_id 7223d5b7-fa56-4ff3-acee-959a5cf5f146, crond active, cron entry present, log contents before reboot
Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent polls show old boot_id still present then connection timeouts/reset during the actual reboot window

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 4ba52a94-c37e-469e-bebf-e7d2eb7e8517 after reconnect, distinct from pre-restart value

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of cron service, job, script, and log data
evidence.summary: crond active/enabled, cron entry intact, script intact (0755 root:root, correct content), and log file shows both the pre-reboot entry and a new post-reboot entry appended (not truncated)
